color.note: One theme: the app ships dark only ("BrandMuse dark luxury theme"). Names with a brandmuse-/bm- prefix are the source's own custom properties; every other name was given here to a literal that styles.css repeats, and its note says where. The app-* tokens are the BrandMuse app's own palette, sampled from app.brandmuse.io, adopted for the Studio's new look.

tokens.name: brandmuse-purple
tokens.usage: The accent. Start of every primary gradient (btn-primary, user chat bubble, recommended avatar), checkbox accent-color, the 3px focus outline, the recommended-row left rule, and the chart series for the recommended plan. As text it is 4.8:1 on the page ground: fine from 19px bold or 24px up, borderline below.

tokens.name: brandmuse-purple-light
tokens.usage: Lavender for small accents: the product label under the sidebar logo, the $ in money fields, typing dots, the + on more-details, the hero search icon, the current-step ring. 7.5:1 on the page ground.

tokens.name: brandmuse-purple-dark
tokens.usage: Deep purple at the start of progress-bar gradients (aud-track, hb-track plan, lo-bar, mid match-pair) and the chat orb's shadow side. Legacy only: the label color of an active toggle-filter or evidence-button, where it reads 3.6:1 on the page ground and fails 4.5:1; the Studio layout uses white on purple-tint fills instead.

tokens.name: purple-500
tokens.usage: Literal. The end of every 135deg primary gradient paired with brandmuse-purple; also the end of bar gradients paired with brandmuse-purple-dark.

tokens.name: purple-400
tokens.usage: Literal. Last stop of the stepper progress bar and the bright side of the chat orb's radial gradient.

tokens.name: purple-200
tokens.usage: Literal. Lavender text on the page ground and bm-surface (11.0:1): hero-label, bold inside a chip, msg-link and link-btn, aud-name on hover, the busy live-pill, tag-little, the no-roster why-tag, and the end of the hero number's text gradient.

tokens.name: purple-100
tokens.usage: Literal. Initials on the soft purple avatar (purple-tint-35 fill).

tokens.name: purple-ink
tokens.usage: Literal. The inactive dataset dot in the sidebar.

tokens.name: brandmuse-light-background
tokens.usage: The page ground. Despite its name (a BrandMuse light-theme variable) styles.css overrides it to near-black; the body then layers two purple radial glows (ground-glow-1 and ground-glow-2) over it, fixed.

tokens.name: brandmuse-light-surface
tokens.usage: Legacy panel fill (.panel, .score-card, .campaign-card, .explore-clusters); same value as bm-surface. New work uses bm-surface.

tokens.name: brandmuse-light-border
tokens.usage: Legacy panel and input border; same value as bm-border. New work uses bm-border.

tokens.name: brandmuse-light-text
tokens.usage: Primary text on the page ground, bm-surface and bm-raised (18.6:1 on the ground, 16.8:1 on bm-raised). The brightest text; headings, names, numbers.

tokens.name: brandmuse-light-muted-text
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the page ground, bm-surface and bm-raised (8.2:1 on the ground, 7.4:1 on bm-raised): helper copy, labels, meta lines, idle nav items, ghost buttons.

tokens.name: brandmuse-dark-background
tokens.usage: BrandMuse frontend dark ground from brand-tokens.css. Not used by this app (it uses brandmuse-light-background); kept so the BrandMuse palette is complete.

tokens.name: brandmuse-dark-surface
tokens.usage: BrandMuse dark surface. The app reads it as bm-solid for native select, input and option backgrounds.

tokens.name: brandmuse-dark-raised-surface
tokens.usage: BrandMuse raised surface. The app uses it literally as the chart tooltip (.chart-tip) background.

tokens.name: brandmuse-dark-border
tokens.usage: BrandMuse dark border. Not used by this app, which draws every hairline with the translucent bm-border.

tokens.name: brandmuse-dark-text
tokens.usage: Pure white. The app uses it literally as text on purple fills: the primary button and user chat bubble (4.2:1 on brandmuse-purple, 4.0:1 at the purple-500 end: a source pair kept exact, below 4.5:1 for its 14px/600 label), the active nav item and active tab (9.5:1 on purple-tint-55), the recommended badge, and the current step label.

tokens.name: brandmuse-dark-muted-text
tokens.usage: BrandMuse muted text. Not used by this app, which uses brandmuse-light-muted-text.

tokens.name: bm-surface
tokens.usage: Card fill over the page ground: .card, .kpi, .chart-card, .panel-lite, .strip-item, .support-item, .more-details, the hero-metric base. Glass cards add backdrop-filter blur(blur-card).

tokens.name: bm-raised
tokens.usage: One step above bm-surface: table header rows, selected rows, chip-cap and the left badge, the assistant chat bubble, btn-secondary, the chat and explore inspectors.

tokens.name: bm-border
tokens.usage: The hairline on every card, input, row divider, sidebar edge and chat edge. 1px, never heavier; meaning is carried by purple or status tints, not by border weight.

tokens.name: bm-solid
tokens.usage: Opaque fill for native form controls (select, input, textarea, option) so dropdown menus do not show the page through them.

tokens.name: bm-chart-repeat
